# Captured workflow excerpt

## Tracker commands
**Query the record live** (`record-cli issue list --repo example/project` / `record-cli issue view`) for any issue state; never answer from a handoff, memory, or summary.

## Repository commands
run `git status` and check for foreign *staged* entries; if present, a bare commit will sweep them into your commit under your message.

## Boundary
Questions are not authorization.
